question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Announced
solution: The correct answer is "Declared."** ***__Key Points__** __ • The word "Announced" means to make something known publicly and officially. (घोषणा करना, ऐलान करना) • Example: *They **announced**__ that our train had been delayed.* • The synonym of "Announced" is "Declared." • The word "Declared" means to state something publicly and officially or to make something known in a firm, clear way. ((कोई बात) सार्वजनिक और आधिकारिक रूप से घोषित करना, (किसी बात की) घोषणा करना) __ • Example: They **declared**__ their support for the proposal.* • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Estrange: **cause (someone) to be no longer on friendly terms with someone. ((किसी को) किसी के साथ मित्रतापूर्ण संबंध न रखने का कारण) • **Secret: **something that is not or must not be known by other people. (गोपनीय बात (जो दूसरों को न पता हो न पता चले), दूसरों से छिपाने योग्‍य बात) • **Hid: **to put or keep somebody/something in a place where he/she/it cannot be seen; to cover something so that it cannot be seen. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऐसी जगह रखना जहाँ कोई देख न सके, छिपाना; किसी वस्‍तु को ऐसे ढकना कि वह दिखाई न दे, छिपा देना) 3c:Tf38, The correct answer is "Twisted."
